summary: Build your own kingdom by playing Royal Solitaire card games and have fun!
description:
Welcome to the unique world of Royal Solitaire! Here is the most fun and new Solitaire game for those who love to play card games. Download now and start exploring the innovative world of Royal Solitaire!
Royal Solitaire is a medieval themed game where you can play card games and build your own kingdom. As you progress through the levels on the map, you can add new buildings to your kingdom and feel like you are living in the middle ages!
You can earn coins as you level up in the card game, you can collect wheat when the wheat in the field grows, you can collect flowers from the florist. There's more to the world of Royal Solitaire than that. Explore this solitaire world and transform it into your own world that you can design yourself.
You will have a lot of fun harvesting the crops and while earning rewards as you play in the kingdom you will build in the world of Royal Solitaire. Advance through difficult levels in the solitaire game to build and design the medieval kingdom of your dreams. Explore decoration items and customize your kingdom to your own tastes!
Royal Solitaire is a game that appeals to all players. This card game has different difficulty levels. While playing the Royal Solitaire game, you will challenge yourself, train your brain and have a lot of entertaining experience!
Features of the Game:

-Simple to learn and fun to play!
-Quick thinking and smart moves in tripeaks solitaire games!
-Harvest the crops, collect the flowers!
-Create the kingdom with your own taste.
-Earn more coins and build a better place!

It's time to show your own talents for your Royal Solitaire kingdom!
Play with smart moves and level up for more rewards! It will be the best game for you to spend time!

Start to play Royal Solitaire now! Interesting rewards and entertaining game are waiting for you! Complete levels to get more coins and enjoy the game!
